concepts.label: vpn-service
concepts.gloss: A customer L3VPN service object that represents the logical VPN instance (service-level construct) which is realized by one or more per-PE vpn-node instances across the provider network.
concepts.example: ACME-L3VPN (3 sites, hub-and-spoke) — the L3VPN service that is realized on vpn-node@PE1 (hub) and vpn-node@PE2/vpn-node@PE3 (spokes) to provide isolated routing for ACME's three sites.

concepts.label: vpn-node
concepts.gloss: A per-provider-edge (per-PE) instantiation of a vpn-service: the PE-local VPN instance that is part-of a vpn-service and is configured on a specific PE device.
concepts.example: vpn-node@PE1 — the PE-local instance of ACME-L3VPN configured on device PE1 (part-of ACME-L3VPN) with RD 65000:101 and exporting RT 'rt 65000:1 (hub)'.

concepts.label: vpn-network-access
concepts.gloss: A vpn-network-access attachment representing the PE-side attachment point or interface where a vpn-node connects and which faces a specific CE (customer edge).
concepts.example: access-PE1-CEA — the access attachment on vpn-node@PE1 that faces CE-A, carries addressing 10.0.1.0/30, and runs eBGP PE1-CEA with qos-profile gold-200M applied.

concepts.label: ce
concepts.gloss: A customer edge (CE) peer entity that peers with a provider edge (PE) across a vpn-network-access to exchange customer routes with the VPN service.
concepts.example: CE-A — the customer edge device that peers with PE1 over access-PE1-CEA using eBGP PE1-CEA to exchange routes for the ACME-L3VPN.

concepts.label: route-distinguisher
concepts.gloss: A route-distinguisher: a per-vpnnode unique identifier attached to routes to make VPN routes globally unique across the provider's routing table and tied to a specific vpn-node.
concepts.example: 65000:101 — the RD assigned to vpn-node@PE1 so that routes exported from vpn-node@PE1 are distinguished from those of other vpn-nodes for ACME-L3VPN.

concepts.label: vpn-target
concepts.gloss: A vpn-target (route-target) policy value used to control import/export membership of routes for a vpn-node (i.e., which VPN routing/route-sets are exported or imported by that vpn-node).
concepts.example: rt 65000:1 (hub) — the route-target applied on vpn-node@PE1 to export hub routes so that vpn-node@PE2 and vpn-node@PE3 that import rt 65000:1 will receive the hub's routes.

concepts.label: ip-connection
concepts.gloss: An IP addressing assignment (ip-connection) allocated to a vpn-network-access attachment, representing the IP subnet or link addresses used on that access.
concepts.example: 10.0.1.0/30 — the IP subnet assigned to access-PE1-CEA connecting PE1 and CE-A, providing the point-to-point addresses for that CE-PE link.

concepts.label: qos-profile
concepts.gloss: A service QoS profile specifying performance treatment (e.g., bandwidth/priority) that is applied on a vpn-network-access to control traffic behaviour for the VPN attachment.
concepts.example: gold-200M — the qos-profile applied to access-PE1-CEA to guarantee up to 200 Mbps and higher priority for ACME's link toward CE-A.

concepts.label: ne
concepts.gloss: A provider edge network element (NE) device that hosts one or more vpn-node instances and terminates customer attachments for VPN services.
concepts.example: PE1 — the provider edge device that hosts vpn-node@PE1, interfaces access-PE1-CEA to CE-A, and runs eBGP PE1-CEA for the ACME-L3VPN.

concepts.label: routing-protocol
concepts.gloss: A routing protocol instance or session configuration that runs on a vpn-network-access to carry control-plane information between a CE and the PE for a vpn-node.
concepts.example: eBGP PE1-CEA — the CE-PE routing-protocol instance running on access-PE1-CEA that exchanges routes between CE-A and vpn-node@PE1 for ACME-L3VPN.

concepts.label: routing-policy
concepts.gloss: A routing policy (import/export policy) that is applied at a vpn-node to control which routes are accepted, filtered, transformed, or exported for that PE-local VPN instance.
concepts.example: ACME-import-policy — the routing-policy applied-at vpn-node@PE2 that filters incoming CE routes to accept only site-specific prefixes for the ACME-L3VPN.

concepts.label: sla-report
concepts.gloss: A service-level assurance report that documents measured SLA metrics (availability, latency, etc.) for a vpn-service over a reporting period.
concepts.example: ACME monthly SLA report — the monthly assurance report for ACME-L3VPN summarizing uptime, packet-loss and latency for the three-site service during the month.

concepts.label: x-op-tag-91
concepts.gloss: A vendor-proprietary opaque attribute (an x-op- tag) attached to a vpn-node used to carry vendor-specific configuration or metadata that is not part of the standard model.
concepts.example: x-op-tag-91=A7 on vpn-node@PE1 — a proprietary attribute stored on vpn-node@PE1 indicating a vendor-specific flag or behavior identified by tag 91.
